title: Soil Health Management, Green Manuring and Biofertilizers
source_name: KVK Baramati & MPKV Rahuri Soil Science Dept
summary: Soil fertility improves sustainably using organic carbon enhancement, green manuring with Dhaincha/Sunnhemp, and integrated biofertilizers.
content: Why Organic Carbon Matters: Ideal soil organic carbon (SOC) is >0.75%. Below 0.5% indicates degraded microbial activity and low fertilizer use efficiency. Steps for Organic Fertility Improvement: 1) Green Manuring: Sow Dhaincha (Sesbania aculeata) or Sunnhemp (Crotalaria juncea) @ 20 kg seed/acre with pre-monsoon shower. Invert and incorporate into soil at 45 days (flowering stage) using rotavator. Adds 80-100 kg atmospheric Nitrogen/ha and 10-15 tons organic biomass. 2) Vermicompost: Apply well-rotted vermicompost @ 2-3 tons/acre or FYM @ 5 tons/acre enriched with Trichoderma viride (2 kg/ton) before last harrowing. 3) Biofertilizers: Seed treatment with Azotobacter / Rhizobium (for legumes) and PSB (Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria) @ 250 g/10 kg seed or soil application @ 2.5 kg/acre mixed in FYM. 4) Jeevamrut Application: Fermented mixture of fresh desi cow dung (10 kg), cow urine (5-10 L), jaggery (2 kg), gram flour (2 kg) and virgin soil (handful) in 200 L water for 4-7 days; apply 200 L/acre through irrigation water twice a month.
